$ rea guidance --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
rea guidance — Search or read the installed REA workflow guidance

Usage: rea guidance [options]

Options:
  --action <search|read>  Guidance action to perform: search or read (default: search)
  --query <string>        Required with search; all non-generic query words must match
  --locator <string>      Required with --action read; locator returned by search
  --limit <value>         Maximum search matches; search only, defaults to 8
  --cursor <string>       Continue a search page; search only

Custom Global Options:
  --timings  Write measured command timing to stderr.

Global Options:
  --filter-output <keys>                      Filter output by key paths (e.g. foo,bar.baz,a[0,3])
  --format <toon|json|yaml|md|jsonl|csv|tsv>  Output format
  --full-output                               Show full output envelope
  --help                                      Show help
  --json                                      Shorthand for --format json
  --llms, --llms-full                         Print LLM-readable manifest
  --no-retain                                 Write no over-budget result to the retained-Evidence cache
  --schema                                    Show JSON Schema for command
  --token-count                               Print token count of output (instead of output)
  --token-limit <n>                           Limit output to n tokens
  --token-offset <n>                          Skip first n tokens of output
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
